baseline: Pre-optimization surfaces.js: vector/triangle objects, string edge adjacency and bounded Octree.
candidate: Typed normals and edge adjacency, exact numeric edge keys, and contiguous face blocks with axis-aligned bounds. No per-triangle objects remain reachable for picking.
timing: Fresh process per sample, alternating baseline and candidate; fixture construction and initial GC excluded. Preparation retains overlay and index. Picking has 20 warmups then 120 measured rays. Samples sorted ascending.
memory: Endpoint follows explicit GC with source geometry, displayed geometry, materials and picking data reachable. JS heap and ArrayBuffers are separate; external includes ArrayBuffers. peakRssKiB includes transient preparation.
verdict: Manual diagnostic without CI timing thresholds. Median ordered preparation 790.36 ms to 154.04 ms, retainedJS about 105.42 MiB to 0.38 MiB. Shuffled picking p95 rises from about 0.023 ms to 3.84 ms, comparable with native raycasting at this workload; ordered p95 stays below 0.04 ms. Retain this tradeoff for faster loading and bounded memory.
behavior: Native-raycaster parity for indexed curved, flat and shuffled triangles across front/back/double sides; material-group visibility, non-manifold boundaries and highlight lifecycle tests.
